description:
Hi! I'm Hasan, a Computer Engineering student at Batman University. For the "Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions" challenge, our team is building a clean, user-friendly web dashboard that monitors astronaut vitals (heart rate, oxygen, sleep, stress) and gives instant emergency alerts with action steps using NASA human health data. Looking for teammates in web dev, UI/UX design, or pitchin

!
